name: saral-erp
description: Saral ERP - business management for Indian companies: double-entry accounting, GST compliance, inventory, sales, procurement, manufacturing and payroll.

scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace server & npm run dev --workspace web
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace web && npm run build --workspace server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace server && npm run typecheck --workspace web
scripts.cf:dev: npm run build --workspace web && wrangler dev
scripts.cf:deploy: npm run build --workspace web && wrangler deploy
